evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
sources_quoted.use: The only damage-amplifier mechanic carried by either item named in the scenario. Melee value 8%, ranged value 5%.

sources_quoted.ref: data/items.json -- {{rd|melee|ranged}} convention, established from sibling entries
sources_quoted.quote: Tiamat / Ravenous Hydra "Cleave": {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}} ; Blade of the Ruined King "Mist's Edge": {{rd|9%|6%}} of the target's current health ; Phage "Rage": {{rd|20|10}} bonus movement speed
sources_quoted.use: All three are known melee/ranged splits with the melee figure first, so {{rd|8%|5%}} reads 8% melee / 5% ranged. 62 {{rd|..}} occurrences scanned; the first slot is uniformly the larger melee value.

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
sources_quoted.use: Bounds the competing hypothesis: the maximum Carve armor reduction is 30%.

sources_quoted.quote: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)   (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... m(R) = 2 - 100/(100 - R) for R < 0
sources_quoted.use: Mitigation multiplier used to bound what an armor-side change can do to a damage number.

sources_quoted.quote: Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8*max_stacks constant ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C
sources_quoted.use: Defines the two candidate Black Cleaver stack models (4 stacks = 24% vs at most 5 stacks = 30%) that were tested and refuted.

sources_quoted.quote: Negative-armor percentage reduction (reduce_resistance): the engine applies percentage reduction only while R > 0.
sources_quoted.use: Third candidate mechanism, tested and refuted.

rounding_consistent_ratio_band.note: Both leaves are reported to 1 decimal, so the true ratio lies in [101.65/94.15, 101.75/94.05].

hypotheses_tested.mechanism: Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' 8% increased damage from all sources (melee value), applied to this event
hypotheses_tested.status: ACCEPTED - unique in-band mechanism among the scenario's named items

hypotheses_tested.mechanism: Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' at the ranged value (5%)
Black Cleaver stack model: 0.8*5 = 4 stacks (24% armor reduction) -> full 5 stacks (30%)
hypotheses_tested.status: rejected - reaching 1.0797 would need armor above ~1500; realistic champion armor (80-200) gives only 1.031-1.050. The Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/h is itself < 5, so it cannot even reach the 30% bound.

hypotheses_tested.mechanism: Negative-armor percentage-reduction guard (stop multiplying an already-negative armor)
hypotheses_tested.status: rejected - the mechanism's global maximum is below the band

forward_check.statement: new = old_unrounded * 1.08 must round to 101.7 while old_unrounded rounds to 94.1

independent_computation.conclusion: The leaf moved by exactly one multiplicative 8% damage amplifier. 8% is the melee value of Bloodsong's 'Expose Weakness' debuff ('take 8%/5% increased damage from all sources' for 4 s), which is precisely the coupled cross-participant effect the scenario name advertises: the Bloodsong holder's Spellblade proc amplifies a roster ally's damage instance. The engine now applies it; previously it did not. No armor-side mechanism available to Black Cleaver (the other named item) can produce a +8.08% swing at any realistic resistance, and neither the ranged 5% branch nor a 5%->8% branch correction fits the rounding band.

caveats: The scenario definition (roster, levels, items, timeline) lives outside data/ and was therefore off-limits under R-18/R-19, so this receipt independently verifies the MULTIPLIER and its wiki source, not the absolute pre-amplifier damage of event[59]. The pre-amp base of ~94.14 is taken as given from the old baseline.

8% is the melee branch of {{rd|8%|5%}}. The verdict assumes the Bloodsong holder in this roster is a melee champion. If the holder were ranged, the sourced value would be 5% and the correct leaf would be ~98.8, not 101.7. Nothing readable under data/ names the roster, so this is the one unverified premise.

An 8% 'increased damage against champions' amplifier also exists on the Press the Attack keystone (data/runes.json), so 8% is corroborated as a real amp magnitude in the cached data even though Bloodsong is the source implicated by the scenario name.
